components.description: High-contrast action trigger with inverted color fill and sharp zero radius.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.75rem; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 1.1rem 2.2rem; border: 1px solid #121417; background-color: #121417; color: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 0; transition: all 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn:hover { background-color: #c83226; border-color: #c83226; color: #ffffff; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-arrow { display: inline-block; transition: transform 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn:hover .ds-arrow { transform: translateX(6px); }

components.name: Outline Spec Button
components.description: Secondary technical spec action trigger with 1px hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 1.1rem 2.2rem; border: 1px solid #121417; background-color: transparent; color: #121417; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 0; transition: all 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background-color: #121417; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Editorial Status Badge
components.description: Translucent status pill with 6px scarlet velocity dot.
components.css: .editorial-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0.35rem 0.85rem; border: 1px solid rgba(18, 20, 23, 0.12); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85); color: #121417; border-radius: 4px; backdrop-filter: blur(8px); } .editorial-badge::before { content: ''; display: inline-block; width: 6px; height: 6px; background-color: #c83226; border-radius: 50%; }

components.name: Technical Field Input
components.description: Stark square text field with 1px hairline stroke and focus highlight.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; max-width: 380px; background-color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; color: #121417; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; padding: 0.9rem 1.15rem; border-radius: 0; outline: none; box-sizing: border-box; transition: border-color 0.18s, box-shadow 0.18s; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #121417; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #121417; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9ca3af; font-size: 0.82rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.overview: The Dosnoventa design language unites the uncompromising mechanical precision of a track bike with the stark typographical restraint of modern European art direction. Interfaces are constructed like high-grade bicycle frames: zero ornamental excess, razor-sharp geometric cuts, generous negative space, and relentless structural clarity.
keyCharacteristics: Zero-Radius Architecture: Strict 0px to 4px corners; eschews friendly rounded pills in favor of industrial precision.
Micro-Tracked Hierarchy: Uppercase sans-serif headers paired with generous letter spacing (0.12em to 0.18em) for metadata and labels.
Tactile High-Contrast Planes: Pure white and rich charcoal cards separated by 1px hairline dividers rather than heavy drop shadows.
Mechanical Restraint: Color is deployed with mathematical precision; scarlet accent coverage remains under 10% of any given view.

rules.name: The Ten-Percent Flare Rule
rules.body: The Racing Scarlet accent (#c83226) must never dominate a layout. It is a high-speed brake-light signal used on <=10% of any surface to guide the eye directly to action.

rules.name: The Dual-Atmosphere Rule
rules.body: Backgrounds and surfaces must cleanly swap between Light (#f8f8fa) and Dark (#0a0b0d) via CSS custom properties without modifying structural hierarchy or layout integrity.

rules.name: The Strict Uppercase Metadata Rule
rules.body: All labels, categories, badges, and button labels must be rendered in uppercase with 0.12em to 0.18em tracking. Body copy and reviews remain in standard sentence casing.

rules.name: The Flat Plane Rule
rules.body: Never apply diffuse multi-layered drop shadows to product cards or containers. Depth belongs to the photography and crisp 1px borders, not artificial blur.

dos: Do maintain sharp 0px corners on primary CTAs, inputs, and collection cards.
Do keep typography hierarchy disciplined: Syne for display, Space Grotesk for titles & labels, Inter for body copy.
Do use Racing Scarlet (#c83226) exclusively as an intentional velocity accent, never as a full-page background flood.
Do write concise, technical, and authentic cycling copy (Columbus Spirit tubing, 144 BCD, 7005 Airplane aluminum).
Do preserve 100% feature parity between Light Mode and Dark Mode.
donts: Don't use playful rounded bubble buttons or soft pill corners (rounded-full or rounded-2xl).
Don't use fuzzy, floating drop shadows to simulate elevation; use 1px borders and surface color shifts.
Don't use generic decorative illustrations, emojis, or stock icons that contradict track cycling reality.
Don't mix more than two accent colors on any single viewport.
Don't allow long lines of text to exceed 75 characters without column wrapping.
